Wrangler Air, own printed box 60×100×36 with snap lid, schematic C (Unit 2Relay + deflate valve)

Printed box, walls 2 mm, flat 2 mm lid on four snap hooks. DinMeter in the upper end wall, two M12 cable glands in the lower end wall. Unit 2Relay along the left wall, Grove 5 cm from PORT.B (yellow G2 = relay 2 compressor next to the Grove plug, white G1 = relay 1 valve at the far end; each relay has a VH3.96-4P plug C A B C behind it, A = +12 V in, B = out); 0-25 V voltage module on the floor at the right, S to G15; left gland: 2 m Grove to the sensor and the violet ARB wire, right gland: power and the orange valve wire. Hover or tap a part for its name. For scale: Galaxy Z Fold7 folded and a cigarette pack (photo: Wikimedia Commons, AKS.9955, CC BY-SA 4.0).
